label: Frozen configuration for the final guided-robot trials (final seed, each task's final runs once).
note: Paths relative to the repository root. configs/trials.json is not hashed: its task and mode switch between runs (mode development -> final); its seeds, trial count, timeout and criteria must equal tasks.<task>.trials_fixed (checked by test_hri_frozen).
sha256_note: Shared by all tasks (perception, gesture, state machine, roadmap, bridge, Unity robot and bridge). Exactly the values recorded for the Task 2 final; test_hri_frozen pins them.
sha256_added_note: Added 2026-10-21 before the Task 1 final, not part of the Task 2 frozen set. hri_trials_metrics.json (in_motion_speed_threshold_mps 0.05, evaluation only) was declared 2026-10-21 before any Task 1 trial. robot.json was last changed in 0c2771d, an ancestor of the Task 2 final commit ce37a56 (git log ce37a56..HEAD -- robot_vision/configs/robot.json is empty), and its LF-normalised sha256 at ce37a56 equals this value.

pose_weights.status: to be confirmed against the Task 2 machine's file
pose_weights.evidence: Downloaded 2026-10-21 on the Task 1 machine from the official Ultralytics assets release v8.4.0 (git-ignored). Equal to pose_model.sha256 in configs/hri_perception.json (frozen, unchanged since the Task 2 final), which HriPerception checks at load, refusing to run otherwise; the Task 2 final ran with --perception vision. The Unity trial runner refuses a final if the local file's sha256 differs.

Task2.route_note: Guided route: B is one of the roadmap endpoints, drawn by GoalSequence(seed) and different every trial. Final run once 2026-10-20 (trials_final_Task2_20261020_172445).

Task1.route_note: Straight A to B: B = roadmap task1_goal (E1) in every trial. Since 2026-10-21 (declared design change, before any Task 1 final run; AUDIT.md section 9) the straight line A -> J1 -> E1 has checkpoints from configs/task1_route.json (default 3: C1 (6.25, -5), J1, C3 (6.25, 5)); at every stop the one worker stands by the roadmap worker_stand rule and shows FORWARD. Python runs with bridge.server --task Task1 (map Task1:C1,J1,C3); the Unity trial runner refuses trials if Python's map differs. Before: one stop (J1). The trial settings are those of Task 2.

route_config.note: Per-task (Task 1 only; Task 2 does not read it). LF-normalised sha256, like the shared hashes. The Unity trial runner refuses a Task 1 final if the local file differs.
